title: browser-check private runtime config
description: Lives OUTSIDE the public plugin: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json (0600, parent 0700) or the path in BROWSER_CHECK_CONFIG. Holds every machine-specific value (host names, absolute paths, ports, socket paths, site classifications). Unknown keys are rejected so a typo cannot silently disable a policy.

mode.description: auto = probe capabilities in the documented order; local = this machine runs the browser; remote = the browser is on another machine reached via Aside remote host and/or SSH-tunneled CDP

bin.description: absolute path of the aside CLI (non-interactive shells may not have it on PATH)

remoteHost.description: Aside remote host device name or remote:<id>; omit in local mode

maxConcurrent.description: single-flight by default: CLI auth refresh has no lock and the relay rate-limits per account

evaluateTimeoutMs.description: one page.evaluate ≤ ~30 s (CDP timeout inside the daemon)

callTimeoutMs.description: one remote repl call ≤ ~60 s or the whole output is lost

socketPath.description: absolute path of the reverse-forwarded Unix socket (0600, parent 0700)

tcpEndpoint.description: http://127.0.0.1:<port> — test-only; every local process can reach a TCP listener

daemonEndpoint.description: http://127.0.0.1:<aside-daemon-port> — probed for a health line only

dir.description: absolute dir under the plugin data dir; screenshots, dumps, metrics (redacted) go here

match.description: origin glob, e.g. https://dev.example.invalid:* — matched on normalized origin+path only, never query/hash

login.description: rotating-refresh = closing a tab mid-request can revoke the whole session family

authPathPrefixes.description: request paths the plugin must never call via repl fetch (login/refresh/logout)
